observations.behavior: Replaces the JSON parsing error message with a more actionable, user-facing instruction, removing the raw JSONDecodeError traceback and column/char details.
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the user experience for PostHog warehouse administrators configuring Google Analytics ingestion. When a user provides malformed JSON for custom reports, the error message now explicitly instructs them to provide a JSON array, rather than exposing internal parser diagnostics.
